title: Blues Traveler - Hook (Official Music Video)
summary: The official music video for Blues Traveler's song Hook, remastered in HD. The song is known for using the melody of Pachelbel's Canon while its lyrics comment on how hooks work.
why: HN mentions it mainly as a music example in threads on shared melodies and on how to craft a compelling hook, with a few jokes.

quote.text: It is especially effective because he is doing all the things he is describing at a high level.
